item.title: Koi to H Shika Shiteinai!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Unison Shift
  • 発売日: 2023-09-29
  • スコア: 6.6/10 (40 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋とHしかしていない！
  • 英語名: Koi to H Shika Shiteinai!

别名

  • Love And H Are All I Have!

あらすじ

I, Kyuujin Shidou, was discovered to be related to the leader of the Mauki Group, the largest corporation in Japan. In order to succeed the leader, my grandfather who did not have much time left to live, I would need a spouse…… In other words, to have a wife, that was the necessary requirement. But even so, all my life, let alone a wife, I never had a girlfriend!

  • 日本語名: あなたに恋する恋愛ルセット
  • 英語名: Anata ni Koi Suru Ren’ai Recette

别名

  • La recette de mon amour pour toi

あらすじ

The recently-founded Rokkasei Gakuen doesn’t have a rich history. One of its notable features is that students will select their specialization during the second term of their first year. Haruma decided to pursue the confectionery course that had been added this school year for the simple reason that he loves sweet a lot.

item.description:

  • 日本語名: 胸キュン!はぁとふるCafe
  • 英語名: Mune Kyun! Heartful Cafe

あらすじ

All of a sudden your twin little sisters return!

The setting is a cafe that the protagonist’s friend is having him run. That’s where his twin step sisters come to live with him until graduation.

The older sister is the subdued Chiyori, and the younger sister is the cheerful and energetic Chika.
